title: Field Sales Executive
description:
WHITE WINDOW TECH 
 Job Description 
 Field Sales Executive Smart Classroom & Enterprise Solutions 
 LocationMumbai, MaharashtraExperience 37 years Compensation 35,00050,000 per month + performance-linked incentives 
About White Window Tech
White Window Tech is focused on building business in the education and enterprise markets through technology products and integrated solutions. Our portfolio may include interactive flat panel displays (IFPDs), smart classroom solutions, CCTV and surveillance systems, smart door locks, access control, audio-visual equipment, workplace collaboration technology, and other complementary solutions.
Role Overview
We are looking for a commercially driven field sales professional to develop new business and manage sales opportunities across educational institutions and corporate customers in Mumbai and the surrounding region. The role combines independent prospecting, relationship-based selling, conversion of company-generated leads, and business development through OEMs, dealers, distributors, and system integrators.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Revenue Generation
 Identify and develop new business opportunities across schools, colleges, universities, corporate offices, and other institutional customers. Generate leads through personal networks, referrals, cold outreach, field visits, industry events, and channel partners. Follow up on company-generated enquiries and marketing leads, qualify opportunities, and convert them into orders. Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and achieve assigned revenue and gross-margin targets. Develop new accounts and expand existing customers through cross-selling and upselling. Education Sector Sales
 Develop relationships with school management, trustees, principals, administrators, IT heads, procurement teams, and educational groups. Identify opportunities for IFPDs, smart classroom solutions, classroom AV systems, CCTV, smart locks, access control, and related campus technologies. Understand institutional requirements, budgets, procurement processes, and purchasing timelines. Arrange product demonstrations, recommend solutions, prepare proposals, negotiate, and close deals. Enterprise & Corporate Sales
 Identify and engage corporate offices, commercial establishments, and enterprise customers. Build relationships with IT heads, facility managers, security heads, administration teams, procurement managers, and other decision-makers. Develop opportunities for meeting-room displays, video conferencing, AV solutions, CCTV, access control, smart locks, and related workplace technology. Manage the sales cycle from prospecting and requirement gathering through proposals, negotiations, purchase orders, and coordination with delivery teams. OEM, Channel Partner & Tender Development
 Build productive relationships with OEMs, distributors, dealers, resellers, and system integrators. Identify opportunities for joint selling, referrals, and partner-led business development. Track relevant institutional tenders and government procurement opportunities, including Government e-Marketplace (GeM), where applicable. Coordinate on quotations, bills of quantities, technical submissions, commercial offers, and tender documentation. Account Management & Customer Relationships
 Maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales process and identify opportunities for repeat business. Coordinate with technical, operations, installation, and after-sales teams to support a smooth customer experience. Develop long-term relationships that generate referrals and account growth. Sales Reporting & Market Intelligence
 Maintain accurate lead, account, opportunity, and activity records in the CRM or designated sales tracker. Provide regular updates on customer meetings, field visits, pipeline status, forecasts, and expected closures. Monitor competitor activity, pricing, market demand, and emerging customer requirements. Work with the Head of Enterprise Sales to execute territory plans and improve sales performance. Required Qualifications & Experience
 Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Engineering, or a related discipline. 37 years of experience in B2B field sales, business development, institutional sales, or enterprise solution sales. Experience selling technology products or solutions to educational institutions, corporates, or other institutional customers. An established professional network in Mumbais education and/or enterprise ecosystem. Demonstrated ability to generate leads, manage opportunities, negotiate commercially, and close business. Strong communication, presentation, relationship-management, and negotiation skills. Ability to work independently, manage a field-sales territory, and pursue sales targets. Willingness to travel for customer meetings and demonstrations. Preferred Experience
 Interactive flat panel displays, smart boards, projectors, and smart classroom solutions. CCTV, video surveillance, electronic security, smart locks, and access-control systems. Audio-visual integration, video conferencing, and workplace collaboration solutions. IT hardware, networking, digital signage, and institutional technology solutions. B2B project sales, channel sales, system-integrator sales, or OEM-led business development. Institutional tenders, government procurement, and GeM. Experience across both education and enterprise segments is an advantage; strong experience in one segment with the ability to develop the other may also be considered. Key Performance Indicators
 Revenue and gross-margin achievement. New customer acquisition and strategic account development. Qualified pipeline generation and opportunity conversion. Customer meetings, product demonstrations, proposals, and deal closures. Business generated through self-sourced leads, company-provided leads, and channel partners. Cross-selling and upselling across the solution portfolio. Quality of sales forecasting, CRM records, and customer follow-up. Compensation & Benefits

Prepare and own the sourcing strategy and quarterly pipeline plan for the Khar commercial project, aligned with the business plan and launch sequence. — Mentor and build the capability of Sourcing Managers, CP Relationship Executives and Sales Coordinators. — Present pipeline health, conversion metrics, network health and competitive intelligence to the Principal — Sourcing & Closing on a regular basis. — Manage external consultants and partners: IPC desk heads, boutique brokerage principals, campaign agencies and event partners. 
 3.2 IPC, Consultant & Investment Sales Network — Build and sustain senior-level relationships at CBRE, JLL, Colliers, Cushman, Knight Frank and Savills — both their Office Leasing and Investment Sales desks. — Negotiate and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with IPC desks — brokerage structures, exclusivity, campaign commitments, performance milestones. — Keep IPCs informed of project progress, inventory, pricing, launch timings and incentives through structured, high-quality collateral and briefings. — Track IPC-wise contribution to pipeline and conversion; drive corrective action on under-contributing desks. 
 3.3 Direct Corporate Occupier Outreach — Identify companies looking to purchase their own office premises, expand operations or consolidate multiple offices in the Bandra-Khar-BKC catchment. — Build relationships with CFOs, CEOs, Promoters, Administration Heads and Corporate Real Estate teams at target corporate buyers. — Design and execute corporate outreach campaigns — targeted mailers, boardroom briefings, closed-door previews, launch invitations. — Qualify corporate buyer intent on company stage, decision-maker, timeline, budget and procurement process. 
 3.4 Institutional Investor, Family Office & HNI Channel — Source 10 Cr–20 Cr+ commercial buyers from Mumbai’s institutional investor, family office and UHNI ecosystem. — Build and sustain working relationships with Mumbai family offices, private wealth desks, chartered accountants, investment advisors and tax consultants who refer HNI buyers. — Create and host investor-focused briefings covering project economics — capital value, lease rental, net yield, exit cap rate, portfolio diversification case. — Qualify investor intent on investment horizon, portfolio allocation, risk appetite and leasing-income preference. 
 3.5 Boutique Brokerage & Commercial CP Network — Build and sustain working relationships with 40–50 Bandra-Khar-BKC commercial brokers and boutique brokerages that deliver consistent business. — Run the CP engagement calendar — JBPs, broker events, launch meets, site walkthroughs, High Teas, quarterly performance reviews. — Design brokerage structures, incentive slabs, campaign spiffs and loyalty programs that drive consistent broker engagement. — Add new CPs to the roster through structured hunting and cold outreach; retire non-performing CPs through professional conversations. 
 3.6 Pipeline Qualification, Site Visits & Hand-off to Closing — Own the first-level qualification of every lead on purchase purpose (self-use / investor / family office), budget, timeline, decision-maker and funding readiness. — Convert qualified leads into high-quality site visits for the Closing team at the Khar sales gallery. — Hand off qualified leads to the Closing Head with complete context, briefing notes and next-action recommendations. — Partner with the Closing team on feedback — lead quality, buyer-readiness, catchment conversion trends — and refine the sourcing filter accordingly. 
 3.7 Sourcing Performance, MIS & Coordination — Maintain a project-wise sourcing MIS covering channel-wise pipeline, meetings generated, site visits delivered, visit-to-negotiation conversion and brokerage disbursal. — Track lead-to-meeting, meeting-to-visit and visit-to-negotiation conversion ratios across every channel. — Coordinate with the Marketing team on catchment-specific outreach, campaign execution and competitor positioning intelligence. — Coordinate with the CRM, Legal and Finance teams on CP registration, brokerage payouts, documentation and buyer onboarding. — Represent Roswalt Realty professionally at IPC events, broker meets, industry forums and corporate interactions. 
 4. COMMERCIAL MARKET & BUYER KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED The candidate must know each of the following thoroughly, including how it shapes buyer conversations and sourcing conversion. 
 Area / Knowledge What the Candidate Must Know Why It Matters Bandra-Khar-BKC Grade-A Market Current capital value bands, absorption trends, upcoming supply, pipeline competition Positions our Khar project credibly vs BKC, Lower Parel and Andheri alternatives

 Position: Sales Manager – Individual Contributor (IC)

 Reporting To: Director – Sales & Marketing / Senior Management 
 2. About Jewel Trendz Pvt. Ltd. Jewel Trendz Pvt. Ltd. is a business consulting, management advisory and exhibition organisation company specialising in the Gems & Jewellery industry. The company creates business opportunities through B2B exhibitions, trade shows, networking platforms, memberships, branding, marketing and sales consultancy for jewellery manufacturers and retailers across India and international markets. 3. Job Purpose The Sales Manager – Individual Contributor (IC) will independently drive sales, generate new business, acquire clients and achieve assigned revenue targets. This is a hands-on sales role focused on individual performance, client acquisition, negotiations and deal closures rather than managing a team. The candidate will be responsible for building a strong sales pipeline, developing relationships with jewellery manufacturers and business owners, and generating measurable revenue for Jewel Trendz. 4. Key Responsibilities A. Individual Sales & Revenue Generation Independently achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets. Generate revenue through exhibitions, trade shows, sponsorships, memberships and other assigned business verticals. Identify potential clients, conduct sales calls, present proposals, negotiate and close deals. Maintain a consistent sales pipeline and convert qualified prospects into paying customers. Drive repeat business, upselling and cross-selling opportunities. B. Business Development & Client Acquisition Identify and approach jewellery manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, brands and corporate clients. Generate leads through outbound calls, WhatsApp, email, referrals, networking and industry databases. Build relationships with business owners, directors and key decision-makers. Identify new customer segments and develop opportunities within the Gems & Jewellery industry. Maintain consistent follow-ups until opportunities are converted or appropriately qualified. C. Exhibition & Event Sales Sell participation packages and exhibition stalls for Jewel Trendz Gems & Jewellery Shows, Corporate Diamond Shows, Silver Shows, Lab-Grown Diamond Jewellery Shows and other assigned events. Promote sponsorships, memberships and related commercial offerings. Communicate exhibition benefits, buyer access, networking opportunities and business potential. Drive new exhibitor acquisition and repeat participation. Coordinate with event operations and client services teams for client onboarding and participation confirmation. D. Key Account & Relationship Management Build and maintain relationships with manufacturers, retailers, exhibitors and sponsors. Understand client requirements and recommend suitable participation packages and services. Develop existing accounts and identify additional revenue opportunities. Maintain professional communication and ensure a high standard of customer service. Encourage repeat bookings, referrals and long-term business relationships. E. Sales Pipeline & Reporting Maintain accurate customer databases, lead records and sales pipeline information. Update the designated CRM or sales tracking system regularly. Submit daily activity reports and periodic sales performance updates. Track calls, meetings, proposals, conversions, bookings and pending follow-ups. Coordinate with finance regarding invoices and payment follow-ups for assigned accounts. Provide realistic sales forecasts and communicate business opportunities to management. F. Commercial Discipline & Accountability Follow approved pricing, discount structures and commercial terms. Ensure accurate communication of company services and customer commitments. Protect confidential customer information and company data. Participate in sales reviews and performance discussions. Take complete ownership of individual targets, sales closures and assigned responsibilities. 5. Qualifications & Experience Minimum graduate in any discipline. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in sales, business development, B2B sales or client acquisition preferred. Proven track record of independently achieving sales targets and closing business. Experience in exhibitions, events, corporate sales, memberships or the Gems & Jewellery industry will be an advantage. Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and closing skills. Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, email, WhatsApp Business and CRM systems. Strong networking, follow-up and relationship-management abilities. 6. Required Skills & Competencies Strong individual sales performance and revenue ownership. Confident prospecting, negotiation and deal-closing capabilities. Excellent communication and client-handling skills. Self-motivation and the ability to work independently. Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving abilities. Disciplined pipeline management and accurate reporting. Professional conduct, integrity and accountability. Ability to perform effectively in a target-driven environment. 7. Compensation Structure Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives Fixed monthly salary based on experience and suitability. Additional incentives linked to eligible sales, revenue generation and target achievement. Incentive calculation, eligibility and payout terms will be governed by company policy. Opportunity to increase earnings through individual sales performance. 8. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated on: Achievement of individual monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Number of qualified leads generated. Lead-to-customer conversion rate. Revenue from exhibition stalls, sponsorships, memberships and assigned services. Number of new clients acquired. Repeat business, customer retention and referrals. Sales pipeline accuracy and follow-up discipline. Timely submission of reports and sales forecasts. Compliance with approved commercial terms. Contribution to payment follow-ups and collection coordination. 9. Why Join Jewel Trendz? Work directly with leading jewellery manufacturers, retailers and industry professionals. Develop a strong professional network in the Gems & Jewellery industry. Take ownership of individual business targets and revenue generation. Earn performance-based incentives in addition to a fixed salary. Build long-term career growth through measurable performance and commercial contribution. We are looking for a confident, commercially driven sales professional who can independently generate business, close deals and deliver measurable results without relying on a team of sales executives. title: Sr. Executive - Sales (Chemicals / Specialty Chemical / Lab Chemicals)
description:
INTRODUCTION K. Patel Group is a diversified, multi-location manufacturing group with a strong presence across Dyes, Chemicals, Specialty Chemicals, Herbal Extracts, Metal, and Realty. The Group is on a strong growth trajectory through new projects and modernization of existing facilities. 
 The Executive / Sr. Executive BD at K. Patel International will be responsible for driving business growth in Specialty Chemicals, Lab Chemicals, and Dyes through strategic market development, customer acquisition, sales execution, sourcing, export commercial costing, and long-term relationship management in line with regulatory and industry requirements. 
 MARKETING & BUSINESS STRATEGY Identify and develop new product segments, markets, applications, and business opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers. Understand customer requirements and provide technical-commercial solutions. Respond to customer enquiries, proposals, and RFPs in coordination with internal teams. Prepare product concepts, segment-wise presentations, and marketing material for customers, exhibitions, trade shows, and conferences. Source and manage lab chemicals, specialty chemicals, and dyes product requirements. 
 SALES & BUSINESS OPERATIONS Generate and qualify business leads and convert enquiries into sustainable business opportunities. Conduct cold calling, outbound sales activities, client meetings, negotiations, and deal closures. Develop, retain, and grow customer accounts through consistent follow-ups and relationship management. Maintain and update prospect and customer databases using CRM, Excel, Salesforce, or other approved systems. Obtain quotations from suppliers for product requirements, negotiate prices and commercial terms, and follow up with suppliers for timely quotations, order processing, and delivery. Track quotations, active and inactive leads, appointments, customer interactions, and conversions. Achieve or exceed assigned annual sales, revenue, and business development targets. 
 EXPORT COSTING, FREIGHT & INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS Coordinate with CHAs, freight forwarders, shipping agents, and logistics partners to obtain competitive freight rates, customs clearance charges, port charges, documentation charges, and other export-related costs. Obtain, compare, and negotiate freight quotations for different destinations, shipment sizes, and modes of transport. Calculate export selling prices in USD and other applicable currencies by incorporating product cost, packing, inland transportation, CHA/port charges, freight, insurance, applicable margins, and other associated costs. Prepare customer-specific international quotations based on applicable Incoterms, including EXW, FCA, FOB, CFR/CNF, CIF, DAP, and DDP, as required. Ensure accurate INR-to-USD and foreign-currency conversions using approved exchange-rate assumptions. Prepare and evaluate end-to-end export costing and ensure that quotations reflect correct freight, Incoterms, payment terms, validity, delivery terms, and margins. Maintain an updated database of freight rates, CHA charges, shipping costs, port charges, and other export-related expenses. Coordinate with internal teams, CHAs, and freight forwarders for shipment planning, export documentation, dispatch schedules, and timely delivery. 
 REVENUE MANAGEMENT & PLANNING Collaborate with management on sales planning, forecasting, and target setting. Prepare sales budgets, customer-wise and segment-wise revenue targets. Maintain an updated sales pipeline and ensure accurate reporting through CRM systems. Support short-term and long-term business development planning initiatives. Monitor customer profitability and commercial viability of opportunities in coordination with management. 
 KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Strong knowledge of chemical / pharmaceutical industry regulations and compliance. Understanding of drug laws, patents, trademarks, manufacturing processes, and relevant commercial considerations. Awareness of government policies related to drugs, chemicals, and healthcare programs. Sound understanding of drug development phases, generic development, and regulatory processes. Strong marketing strategy, negotiation, customer engagement, and business development skills. Excellent networking, communication, presentation, and relationship-building capabilities. Strong understanding of export costing, international freight, CHA/customs processes, shipping documentation, and Incoterms 2020. Ability to independently calculate EXW, FOB, CFR/CNF, CIF, DAP, and DDP pricing and convert domestic costing into competitive international selling prices. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to evaluate product cost, supplier quotations, freight, logistics costs, margins, and international selling prices. Good analytical skills and proficiency in Excel/CRM tools for costing, reporting, pipeline management, and sales analysis. 
 QUALIFICATION Bachelors Degree / M.Sc. / MBA; Science / Chemistry preferred. 
 EXPERIENCE Minimum 7+ years of experience in Business Development / Sales. Experience in Specialty Chemicals, Dyes, Lab Chemicals, export sales, or international business is preferred. 
 INDUSTRY TYPE Chemicals & Dyes

description:
Role: Business Development Executive Location: Thane Experience : Freshers are welcome to apply 
 About Boston Institute of Analytics (BIA) The Boston Institute of Analytics is one of the top-ranked international education and training institutes, headquartered in Boston, USA, with 107 campuses across 7+ countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, South Africa, and India. BIA delivers industry-leading programs across new-age technical and non-technical disciplines, helping students and professionals build future-ready careers in the world's most in-demand fields. Our programs emphasize practical learning, career-focused training, and global certification pathways, enabling learners to develop the skills required to succeed in competitive global industries. 
 Role Overview - Boston Institute of Analytics is looking for a Business Development Executive / Sales Coordinator to join the team at our Thane location and support the admissions and academic counselling process. - The role involves engaging with prospective students, supporting academic counsellors, coordinating counselling sessions, managing student inquiries, maintaining accurate CRM records, and assisting with various pre-admissions activities. - The candidate will play an important role in ensuring that prospective students receive timely information and a smooth experience throughout the initial stages of their admissions journey. - This position requires strong communication, coordination, interpersonal, and organizational skills , along with the ability to manage multiple student inquiries and activities in a fast-paced environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Pre-Admissions Support Assist academic counsellors in managing prospective student inquiries and supporting the initial stages of the admissions process. Respond to initial student inquiries and provide relevant preliminary information about BIA's programs. Schedule counselling appointments and coordinate with prospective students regarding their counseling sessions. Ensure that relevant information is communicated to prospective students in a timely and organized manner. Support the admissions team with activities related to the pre-admissions process. 
 2. Student Engagement Interact with prospective students and understand their queries related to available programs. Provide information and guidance regarding course options, prerequisites, and the application process. Maintain regular communication with prospective students and ensure their queries are addressed appropriately. Support students by providing relevant information during the early stages of their admissions journey. 
 3. Academic Counselor Coordination Work closely with academic counselors to coordinate counseling sessions for prospective students. Assist counselors by organizing relevant student information and materials required for counseling sessions. Ensure that counselors have the necessary information about prospective students before scheduled interactions. Coordinate with the counseling team to ensure smooth communication and follow-up with prospective students. 
 4. CRM & Data Management Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospective student inquiries in the CRM system. Record relevant student interactions, follow-ups, and communication details. Ensure that student information is properly maintained and organized for easy reference. Support the admissions team in maintaining accurate lead and inquiry records. 
 5. Student Follow-Ups Conduct structured and timely follow-ups with prospective students. Respond to student inquiries and ensure that relevant information is shared within appropriate timelines. Maintain records of follow-up activities and student interactions in the CRM. Coordinate with academic counselors whenever additional information or support is required during the follow-up process. 
 6. Information Sessions & Virtual Meetings Assist in organizing webinars, information sessions, and Q&A sessions for prospective students. Support the coordination of virtual meetings and student interactions. Help ensure that prospective students receive the necessary information and support during these sessions. Coordinate with the relevant team members to support the smooth execution of online student engagement activities. 
 7. Market & Student Insights Collect feedback and insights from prospective students during their interactions with the admissions team. Identify and document common queries, concerns, and feedback received from prospective students. Share relevant feedback and observations with the admissions team. Support the team in using these insights to improve student engagement and communication strategies. 
 8. Reporting & Admissions Support Assist in preparing reports related to student inquiries, follow-up activities, and admissions metrics. Maintain relevant records and information required for admissions reporting. Support the admissions team in tracking student interactions and inquiry-related activities. Provide accurate information and updates to support the team's admissions-related reporting 
 Qualifications & Skills 
 Bachelor's degree in Education, Business Administration, or a related field . Minimum 1 year of experience in admissions support, academic coordination, business development, or counseling roles. Proficiency in Microsoft Office , including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Familiarity with CRM systems or lead management tools is preferred. Strong verbal and written communication skills . Strong organizational and interpersonal skills . Ability to coordinate effectively with students, academic counselors, and internal teams. Ability to manage multiple tasks, inquiries, and activities in a fast-paced environment . Good attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and follow-ups. 
 Why Join BIA? Work in the fast-growing EdTech and career-training industry . Interact with students and working professionals from diverse backgrounds. Get exposure to admissions, career counseling, inside sales, and student engagement. Learn and grow with an expanding international education organization. Opportunity to build a career in education sales and business development .

title: Export Account Executive
description:
Job Description Export Accountant 
 Department: Accounts & Finance
 Designation: Export Accountant
 Experience: 57 Years
 Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Reporting To: Accounts Manager / Finance Manager
 Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced Export Accountant to manage export-related accounting, export documentation, banking transactions, GST compliance, receivables, and coordination with banks, freight forwarders, customs agents, and internal departments. The candidate should have sound knowledge of accounting principles, export procedures, foreign currency transactions, and applicable statutory requirements.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Export Accounting & Documentation 
 Record export sales, export invoices, credit notes, debit notes, and related accounting entries. Maintain accurate records of export shipments, customer accounts, and foreign currency transactions. Verify commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, bills of lading, airway bills, and other export documents. Reconcile export sales with shipping and customs documentation. Maintain customer-wise export receivables and outstanding reports. 2. Banking & Foreign Exchange 
 Coordinate with banks for export bill submission, negotiation, and collection. Track export payment realisation and follow up on overdue export receivables. Maintain records of inward remittances and bank realisation documents, including e-BRC where applicable. Coordinate with banks for foreign exchange conversion, bank charges, and exchange differences. Assist with monitoring compliance with applicable RBI and FEMA requirements. 3. GST & Statutory Compliance 
 Assist in GST compliance for export transactions, including LUT/bond documentation where applicable. Reconcile export invoices with GST returns and shipping bill details. Support refund claims relating to eligible zero-rated exports, including follow-up on documentation and discrepancies. Coordinate with consultants and auditors for GST, statutory audits, and export-related assessments. Maintain records for applicable export incentives and regulatory documentation. 4. General Accounting & Reconciliation 
 Prepare bank, customer, vendor, and ledger reconciliations. Monitor accounts receivable and payable and resolve discrepancies. Pass journal entries for foreign exchange gains/losses, provisions, and month-end adjustments. Support monthly closing, trial balance review, and financial reporting. Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all transactions. 5. Coordination & Reporting 
 Coordinate with sales, purchase, logistics, stores, production, and dispatch teams. Liaise with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping companies, and banks. Prepare shipment-wise cost statements and export receivable reports. Maintain export documentation files and ensure timely availability of records for audits. Provide regular updates on outstanding payments, shipment status, and pending documentation. Educational Qualification 
 B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification. Additional training in export-import documentation or taxation will be an advantage. Required Skills & Experience 
 57 years of relevant experience in export accounting, preferably in a manufacturing or trading company. Strong knowledge of accounting principles and GST. Practical experience in export documentation and foreign currency accounting. Working knowledge of LUT, shipping bills, bank realisation documentation, and export payment follow-up. Good Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookups, and reconciliations. Experience with Tally, SAP, Oracle, or another ERP/accounting system. Strong coordination, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.

Key Skills: Tally,Gst,Taxation,Payables,Documentation,Export documentation,Export,Accounts payable

Job Summary 
 At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market. What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture. Our customers rank among the who s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform. Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins - big and small. Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let s build what s next - together! Here at Anaplan, we have reinvented how companies see, plan, and run their businesses. Our platform allows our customers to uncover new insights, connect their strategy to their plans, and work in ways they had not previously thought possible. We re growing fast, constantly innovating, and couldn t be prouder to help our customers move forward with confidence in a sophisticated and changing world. We are looking for forward-thinking people who put customer experience at the forefront of every decision. Individuals who thrive on challenges and are ready to grasp the opportunity of a lifetime. Because we fundamentally believe every colleague brings outstanding value to our whole. We are a workplace where each person feels seen, heard, and valued, and can contribute their unique talent to our collective effort. We believe that for ourselves and for our customers. Anaplan is looking for a driven and dynamic Senior Manager, Sales Operations to join our APAC Field Operations Organization. This is a critical role to drive the day-to-day operations for our India business. Think of this role as our Area Vice President's Right Hand person and key business partner while also supporting the strategic initiatives of the Managing Director, APAC. The position will be based out of our Mumbai office and report to the Senior Director of APAC Sales Operations. 
 
 In This Role, You Will Utilize: 
 Your analytics skills to diagnose issues and prescribe the help the sales team needs Your strategic thinking on where the best opportunities are and how to resource against them in the form of territories and account assignments Your operator mindset to help the team execute at the highest possible level Your leadership and facilitation skills to support the teams Rhythm of Business processes (e.g., weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, Quarterly Reviews) Your technical expertise to root cause anomalies or challenges in the business to course correct, improve processes, and drive operational alignment Your empathy and ability to connect with sales leaders, account executives, and other GTM leaders to help them achieve big and bold objectives Ideally, you have helped scale a hypergrowth business past $1B in revenue. You are a detail-oriented operator who is passionate about both the art and science of sales. You know how to define a champion, you get why adoption matters in SaaS, and you take pride in helping your sales team deliver high quality deals that translate into strong customer engagements. Most importantly, you have strong opinions on the best way to engage with and motivate a sales team, and you will thrive in an entrepreneurial environment that will give you a unique opportunity to prove your ideas out. 
 
 Qualifications: 
 9+ years of relevant sales operations experience in a fast-growing sales organization Experience working with enterprise technology companies. SaaS experience is a preference. Proven skills in sales cadence, sales forecasting, funnel maintenance and reporting. Ability to work with cross functional teams. Proven skills in go-to-market modeling, building territories and setting corresponding goals. Excellent analytical skills with experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity and outcomes. Ability to plan, manage and deliver multiple concurrent and complex workstreams in a matrixed organization with aggressive timelines. Experience with account and territory planning. (MEDDPICC experience is a plus.) Ability to manage high volumes of work, prioritize multiple high importance responsibilities and be effective in fast-paced work environments. Must have GRIT - guts, reliability, improvement, teamwork 
 
 Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) 
 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren t just words on paper - this is what drives our innovation, it s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

title: RTFX-Trade & Forex Sales Manager - Mumbai
description:
Role & responsibilities: Sale of International Trade and Forex products to customers of mapped branches; Carrying out enhanced due diligence from TBML perspective and Onboarding of customers referred by branches for international trade and forex products; day to day management of customers availing international trade and forex products to ensure customer satisfaction, ensuring maximization of revenue from these products, and ensuring compliance to the FEMA, RBI and other regulatory guidelines in respect of these products; owning the RTFX target jointly with the mapped branches. 
 A. Business Targets: 1. To achieve RTFX Income Target on entire range of Trade & Forex products, viz., Imports/ Exports/ Bank Guarantees & LCs / Buyer's Credit/ FDI/ODI/ ECB, A2 remittances, Currency Sale/Purchase, Forex Cards, FCY DDs, inward and outward Remittances etc. 2. Ensuring each of the mapped branches meets its RTFX income target. 3. Ensuring each managed portfolio in the mapped branches becomes active on RTFX products 
 B. New Customer Acquisition: 1. Joint visits/calls with branch staff to prospective customers being acquired by the branch for pitching RTFX products. 2. Carrying out enhanced due diligence on the customers referred by branch to determine their suitability for RTFX products from FEMA and TBML perspective. 
 C. Activation of Existing Customers on RTFX Products: 1. Training branch staff and portfolio owners on the RTFX products to enable them to pitch the same to existing customers in the day to day interactions. 2. Joint visits/calls with branch staff to existing customers to activate them on RTFX products. 3. Carrying out enhanced due diligence on the customers referred by branch to determine their suitability for RTFX products from FEMA and TBML perspective. 
 D. Retention of customers availing RTFX products: To continuously engage with customers availing RTFX products to 1. Ensure seamless and fast delivery of customer requirements to his satisfaction 2. Ensure against any poaching attempt by competition 3 .Maximise banks share of his wallet. 4. Identify any possible change in customer business/ profile/ transactions that could be ground of suspicion for any FEMA violation/ TBML angle. 
 E. Business Development: 1. To identify potential RTFX segments/industries in the branch catchment and working jointly with branches to effectively tap the business opportunity. 2. Support the branch in creating visibility for RTFX products, and driving marketing promotions in the catchment in coordination with regional marketing teams 3. Push centrally driven business contests and campaigns in the mapped branches with BMs, CHs, Circle Heads Regional Marketing Team and TFMS. 
 F. Maximising Revenue: 1. Negotiation and finalization of pricing both on exchange margin and commission with the customer for RTFX products. 2. Negotiation and finalization of transaction specific exchange rate with customers availing IBR linked pricing and getting the same booked with Treasury on a back to back basis 3. Periodic review and rationalization of customer specific pricing based on actual volumes and revenue 4. Periodic renegotiation and finalization of revised pricing to counter competition offers 5. Selling Forward Cover as a hedging solution to maximise exchange income for the Bank and minimize exchange risk for the customers. 
 G. Documentation & Approvals: 1. Guiding the customer on documentation requirements for various RTFX products and related transactions. 2. Supporting the customer in curing of deficiencies in documents submitted, which are rejected by Operations. 3. Putting up deviation cases to designated authorities with required justification and obtaining required approvals. 
 H. Adherence to RTFX Desk Processes: 1. To meet extant score card objectives and work as per the extant Sales processes. 2. To ensure achievement of Cross Sell targets. 3. To ensure momentum in business by having regular interactions with respective Branch Managers and Cluster Heads. 4. To ensure review and closure of all Trade Customer leads received from branches in CRM Next. 
 I. Product Knowledge, Innovation and Providing Solutions: 1. To champion the closure of all New /Complex/Complicated/Unique transactions at the unit level by co-ordinating with TSHs/RSHs, and other stakeholders viz., Client, Branch, Trade Desk, CPU-T, Product, Credit, Audit and Compliance. 2. To serve as single point of contact for all queries from directly mapped branches and their customers and assist in their satisfactory closure. 3. To resolve all RTFX Product/Process/System queries of managed branches. 
 J. Risk Mitigation, Monitoring and Portfolio Quality: 1. Ensuring regulatory compliance of all RTFX related transactions 2. Identification and Reporting of suspicious and/or doubtful customers/transactions involving possible FEMA violations and/or TBML cases 3. Follow up for submission of evidence of import (BOE), regularization of export advances received, submission of shipping bills in respect of exports done, realization of export proceeds, submission of regulatory reportings related to FDI, ODI and ECB transactions 4. To ensure that all customers who have booked forward cover, buyer's credit, import LCs and foreign bank guarantees, top-up the required shortfall in MTM (Marked to Market) Fx margin by mobilising additional amount as FD. 5. In case of shortfall, beyond the stipulated time, need to follow-up for recovery, for all cases where the contracts have been cancelled. 
 K. Audit & Compliance: 1. To monitor and ensure requisite operations and risk control as per extant procedures of the bank with regard to Trade and Forex products. 2. To understand, review and extract necessary inputs from the Branch audit report with respect to the RTFX Operations, and utilise it as a feedback for necessary training and hand-holding for the respective branch staff. 
 L. Training and Capacity Building: To identify the knowledge gaps in branch staff on RTFX products and services and train them accordingly with a view to ensuring achievement of RTFX Business objectives. 
 Educational Qualifications: • MBA (Finance /Marketing) CDCS/CITF/CTF/CFE/ other professional certification in trade / forex 
 Key skills: • Should possess good communication skills written and verbal Sound Product and Process knowledge on banking especially on Trade and Forex Services. Should exhibit strong analytical and reasoning skills. Should be able to utilize market information and should be able to translate it into business opportunities. Ability to identify business potential and increase RTFX customers base in the managed branches/cities. Ability to support and hand-hold TFSMs and branch RMs/ABMs/PBs on new Trade Customer acquisition and retention of existing clients by understanding their needs and customising solutions, including hedging solutions. Should be able to train respective TFSMs and branch staff and impart knowledge on RTFX Products and Services and help execute complicated transactions in compliance to the extant regulatory guidelines. Should have maturity and experience to judge and cross check customer level pricing in tune with customer's volume, profitability, competition benchmarking and market dynamics, and recommend to competent authority for approval. To demonstrate a "CAN DO" attitude and conduct business reviews with Cluster Heads and Circle Heads. Good interpersonal skills to manage team, internal and external customers. Should have strong communication skills and should be able to address large groups effectively. To execute adhoc business objectives assigned by Senior Management from time to time. Effective Task Management Skills in order achieve parallel outcomes within the given resources viz., manpower, time frame, et.al. 
 Experience Required: 2 years work experience in a Bank handling Trade/Forex customers Specific Knowledge: Banking Laws & Practice, Team Management, Trade Finance, Retail Forex, Credit, & Hedging Solutions. 
 Major Stakeholders (intra team and cross functional stakeholders, who would need to be interacted with for discharging duties) Customers Branch Banking Team Trade Operations, LSS/CAD, BB Operations RTFX Product Team Treasury WBO Audit Compliance Credit & Market Risk

 Department: Sales

 Location: Navi Mumbai Job Summary We are looking for a Frontline Sales Executive to drive residential property sales by generating and converting leads, engaging with prospective customers, conducting site visits, and guiding clients throughout the sales journey. The ideal candidate should have strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and closing skills, along with a customer-focused approach and an understanding of the residential real estate market.

Conduct property/site visits and provide professional project presentations. Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable properties. Address customer queries and objections effectively. Sales Conversion Convert qualified leads into site visits, bookings, and sales. Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines. Team Coordination Coordinate with Sales Team Leaders, Regional Heads, Marketing, CRM, and other internal teams. Share customer feedback, market insights, competitor information, and lead quality feedback with the management. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer queries and ensure a smooth sales process. Client Relationship Management Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing customers. Provide timely updates and support throughout the purchase process. Ensure a positive customer experience from initial enquiry through booking and post-sales coordination. Coordinate with the CRM team for customer onboarding and after-sales support. CRM & Sales Reporting Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, follow-ups, site visits, bookings, and conversions in the CRM. Update customer information and sales activities regularly. Track individual performance, conversion ratios, and sales pipeline. Submit weekly and monthly sales reports to the reporting manager. Ensure timely completion of booking forms, agreements, payment documentation, and other sales-related records. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong presentation and negotiation skills Proven sales and customer-handling ability Strong persuasion and closing skills Customer-centric approach Good knowledge of residential real estate and property sales Strong follow-up and relationship management skills Proficiency in CRM software and MS Office Ability to work under sales targets and deadlines Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills

title: Tele Counsellor
description:
Company: Insight Education Consultancy
 Location: Baner, Pune, Maharashtra
 Job Type: Full-Time | Work from Office
 Department: Student Counselling & Admissions
 Experience: 03 Years
 Salary: 15,000–25,000 per month + Performance Incentives
 Working Days: 6 Days a Week About Insight Education Consultancy Insight Education Consultancy is a medical admission consultancy based in Baner, Pune, specializing in NEET UG, MBBS admissions in India and abroad, NEET PG, and MD/MS admissions . We assist students and parents in understanding medical admission opportunities, college selection, counselling procedures, fee structures, and admission requirements. We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and target-oriented Telecallers to connect with NEET UG and NEET PG aspirants, explain our admission counselling services, understand their requirements, and generate qualified leads for our student counselling team. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to build trust with students and parents over the telephone. Key Responsibilities 1. Outbound Calling to NEET Aspirants Make outbound calls to NEET UG and NEET PG aspirants from the company's database. Contact students and parents who have enquired about MBBS, MD/MS, or medical admission counselling services. Explain the services offered by Insight Education Consultancy. Understand students' NEET scores, ranks, admission preferences, and counselling requirements. Inform students about relevant admission procedures, counselling processes, and available guidance services. Identify students who are actively looking for admission assistance. Encourage interested students and parents to connect with the admission counselling team. 2. Student Counselling and Enquiry Handling Communicate professionally with students and parents regarding medical admission counselling. Provide basic information about: NEET UG and MBBS admissions. NEET PG and MD/MS admissions. Government and private medical colleges. Deemed universities and applicable admission quotas. MBBS admission opportunities in India and abroad. Counselling procedures and admission timelines. Understand students' academic profiles, preferences, and budget requirements. Answer routine questions using company-approved information. Transfer complex admission-related queries to the senior counsellor or admission expert. Maintain a polite, professional, and helpful approach during every interaction. 3. Lead Generation and Follow-ups Identify potential students who are interested in the company's admission counselling services. Qualify leads based on their admission requirements, eligibility, interest level, and readiness to proceed. Schedule counselling appointments for interested students and parents. Follow up with prospective students who require additional information or time to make a decision. Maintain regular communication with interested students according to the company's follow-up process. Reconnect with previous enquiries when appropriate. Ensure that promising leads are handed over to the counselling team promptly. 4. Database and CRM Management Maintain accurate records of all calls and student enquiries. Update student information in the company's CRM, lead management system, or designated database. Record call outcomes, student interests, follow-up dates, and counselling appointments. Maintain separate lead records for NEET UG and NEET PG aspirants. Ensure that student information is accurate, confidential, and handled responsibly. Avoid duplicate entries and maintain proper follow-up records. 5. Achievement of Calling Targets Complete the assigned daily outbound calling targets. Generate qualified leads and counselling appointments. Follow up consistently with interested students. Work towards individual and team performance targets. Maintain high standards of call quality and professional communication. Participate in regular performance reviews with the team leader or manager. 6. Coordination with the Admission Counselling Team Coordinate with admission counsellors to ensure smooth lead handovers. Share relevant student information before scheduled counselling sessions. Follow up on leads assigned by the counselling team. Obtain updates on student enquiries and appointment outcomes. Support the team during peak NEET UG and NEET PG admission and counselling seasons. Required Skills and Qualifications Educational Qualification: Minimum 12th pass; graduates will be preferred. Candidates with backgrounds in commerce, arts, management, or other disciplines are welcome. Required Skills: Excellent verbal communication skills. Fluency in Hindi is essential. Knowledge of English is preferred. Marathi-speaking candidates will have an added advantage. Confidence in speaking with students and parents over the telephone. Good listening, persuasion, and follow-up skills. Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets. Ability to maintain accurate records of calls and student enquiries. Professional telephone etiquette and a positive attitude. Willingness to work towards daily and monthly targets. Preferred Experience: Experience in telecalling, telesales, education counselling, student admissions, or customer support will be an advantage. Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn can also apply. Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is: Confident and comfortable making outbound calls. Patient and professional while speaking with students and parents. Capable of explaining information clearly and persuasively. Interested in working in the education and medical admissions industry. Consistent with follow-ups and database management. Motivated by targets and performance-based incentives. Responsible when handling confidential student information. Willing to learn about NEET UG, NEET PG, and medical admission procedures. Important: This role requires active outbound calling. Candidates must be comfortable speaking with a high volume of prospective students and parents every day.  Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide 
 Career Development Ocer (CDO) 
 1. About Jaro Education 
 Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive 
 and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self- 
 funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership 
 Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress. 
 Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious 
 professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C- 
 Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools, 
 including: 
 IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli, 
 IIM Visakhapatnam 
 IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee, 
 E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras 
 Technology Innovation Hub 
 Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business 
 Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership, 
 MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University 
 Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology 
 Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU, 
 Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth 
 Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN 
 Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University 
 Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) / 
 SSODL 
 Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG 
 in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman 
 School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive 
 Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals 
 around the world. 
 Page 1 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every 
 student and professional at all stages of their career. 
 2. Role Overview & Snapshot 
 The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving 
 business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them 
 on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead 
 generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching. 
 Designation 
 Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist 
 Admissions & Executive Education Sales 
 Department 
 Target Audience 
 Working Days 
 Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers 
 Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O) 
 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business 
 requirements) 
 Working Hours 
 Dress Code 
 Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals 
 Primary CRM Tool 
 LeadSquared 
 3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations 
 High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting 
 ¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM 
 database to build a healthy sales pipeline. 
 ¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport 
 with high-potential prospects. 
 Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis 
 ¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career 
 aspirations. 
 ¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or 
 certications from Jaros university partners. 
 ¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum 
 highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes. 
 Page 2 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment 
 ¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection 
 handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures. 
 ¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion 
 rates. 
 ¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue 
 metrics. 
 Operations & Data Management 
 ¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment 
 stages in LeadSquared. 
 ¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a 
 seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners. 
 ¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor 
 oerings. 
 4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites 
 ¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional 
 communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred. 
 ¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation 
 capabilities. 
 ¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort 
 working in target-driven environments. 
 ¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to- 
 senior working professionals. 
 ¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like 
 LeadSquared. 
 5. Career Growth Pathway 
 ¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader, 
 Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements. 
 Page 3 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 Interview Preparation Kit 
 Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with 
 Jaro Education. 
 A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules 
 1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate 
 professionalism. 
 2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone, 
 and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings. 
 3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes 
 or o-topic details. 
 4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout 
 the conversation. 
 5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when 
 discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues. 
 B. Fundamental Concepts to Master 
 1. What is EdTech? 
 Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and 
 hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and 
 eectiveness. 
 Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing 
 working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers. 
 2. What is Consultative Selling? 
 Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather 
 than aggressively pushing a product. 
 Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a 
 professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic 
 executive program that aligns with their career growth. 
 Page 4 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies 
 Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual 
 candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example 
 types to aid your preparation. 
 ¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements." 
 Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and 
 everyday responsibilities. 
 ¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?" 
 Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and 
 the impact of upskilling working professionals. 
 ¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?" 
 Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the 
 prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and 
 discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support). 
 ¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?" 
 Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure, 
 career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry). 
 ¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?" 
 Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively 
 (certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities). 
 D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview 
 Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and 
 mission. 
 
 Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive, 
 Harvard Business Impact). 
 
 Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements. 
 
 Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech. 
 
 Dressed in crisp business formal attire. 
 
 All the best for your interview!

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Analyst, Sales Updated: August 4, 2026 
 Company Overview Motivated by unwavering values, and ingrained with a passion for innovation, Michelman is a global developer and manufacturer of specialized sustainable chemistry used in industrial and agricultural coatings, digital printing, consumer packaging, and advanced composites for automotive and aerospace. From helping grow food and keep it fresh, to making vehicles lighter and more fuel efficient, to shielding our homes from the elements, Michelmans environmentally conscious solutions protect and enhance the materials that shape our world. 
 General Summary Reporting to the Asia Sales Director, provide analytical, project and systems support to the Sales Directors, Sales Associates and Asia Region. Provide Sales Process oversight and compliance in order to effectively communicate results, identify risks and drive efficiency within the Sales Department. 
 Primary Responsibilities Sales Analysis: Analyze historical results, identify trends, recommend adjustments to projections and serve as the central partner to inform Sales Directors on important developments. Support analysis of SalesForce opportunities and business at risk. Provide quarterly analysis of the opportunities portfolio evolution at market segment level. Report Generation: Prepare scheduled and ad hoc reports. Preparation of Monthly Commercial reports, including projected figures for the full year and sales pipeline analysis. Financial Objectives: Participate in the development and implementation of annual operating plans with focus on Volume, Revenue and Price projections. The role includes tracking of the monthly reforecast and relevant deviations as well as rebate monitoring and calculation. Price Coordination: Work in close collaboration with the product management team to identify cost and profit variations and coordinate the implementation of price changes. Market Segmentation Management: Maintain high level of focus on customer intimacy through accurate customer segmentations, adherence to service level offerings and coordination with regional peers to ensure global consistency. Team Work: Assist with the reporting and communication of sales opportunities, strategies and progress. Help the sales team by identifying gaps and maintaining SalesForce opportunities and volume forecasts. Systems Expertise: Be an expert in critical Sales Process systems including but not limited to JD Edwards, Cognos, Power BI, SalesForce and any other pertinent systems. Work with IT to improve the use of technology tools including AI to improve timely sales metrics and reporting. Process Improvement : Assist Sales Directors in the design and maintenance of processes which improve sales effectiveness. Special Projects: Lead or represent the Sales Department in sales specific or cross-functional teams and perform special projects as needed. This includes Force Majeure coordination and weekly Sales orders follow up with a cross-functional team. Administrative Support: SalesForce support, follow-up on contracts, rebates, NDAs, cleaning of item codes, base prices, customer accounts, etc., in the system. Other: Perform related duties as assigned or as the situation dictates. 
 Critical Competencies, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Equipped with professional sales analytics capabilities. Capable of sales performance forecasting using historical data and statistical analysis. Able to build, maintain and optimize sales KPI reports and dashboards to track business performance and support data-driven sales strategies. Highly proficient in Salesforce, CRM systems and sales enablement tools. Expertly skilled in Microsoft Office, especially Excel as well as PowerPoint and Outlook for business delivery. Possess rigorous attention to detail, capable of managing and optimizing system utilization to support daily sales operations efficiently. Strong presentation and cross-functional communication skills. Effectively deliver analytical findings, align stakeholders and influence data-driven business decisions. Capable of independent work and multi-task management. Organize and deliver multiple concurrent projects accurately and efficiently from initiation to completion. Strong ownership, accountability and result orientation. Proactively collaborate and deliver reliable, high-quality outcomes fully aligned with organizational goals. Agile in adapting to evolving business needs. Proactively identify optimization opportunities and drive continuous process and performance improvement. 
 Education and Experience Bachelors degree in a Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Statistics, or a related field. A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience, preferably in a multi-national company. Combining sales operations or data analysis for a large team across Asia. Advanced proficiency in IT system tools like JDE, SalesForce, Power BI, Microsoft Office Suite (specifically Excel for data analysis and PowerPoint for presentations) is essential. Familiarity with a formalized sales process, such as Miller-Heiman. Fluent English speaker. 
 Other Able to travel up to 10% of the time by car or plane to visit regional base of customers. Based in Mumbai, able to perform job duties at remote locations such as industrial sites, customer centers, and other locations.

title: Senior Executive - International Sales
description:
Senior Executive - International Sales Company: ALAN Electronic Systems Private Limited Department: International Sales Location: Head Office, Ambernath, Maharashtra (international travel required) Reporting To: Head of Department - International Sales Experience: 8-12 years Role Overview The Senior Executive - International Sales owns the execution quality of ALANs international sales administration: order processing, export documentation, dispatch, payment collection and partner support. The role leads the Executive and Junior Executive who perform these tasks and is accountable for every activity being completed within the defined timelines. The role also resolves technical issues raised by sales partners on ALAN products, prepares AOP data and presentations, plans and executes the Annual Sales & Service Partners Meeting (ASPM), and represents ALAN at international exhibitions and conferences. Key Responsibilities 1. Order Processing Oversight Ensure partner POs are received, verified against the approved price list, discounts, payment terms, and booked in ERP within the defined TAT Review and approve proforma invoices and order confirmations before release to the partner Ensure country-specific requirements are checked before booking: product registration, CE certificate validity, import permits and labelling Review partner credit status and outstanding dues on each order; take exceptions to the HoD for approval Review the order register daily for pending, delayed and incorrectly booked orders 2. Fulfilment and Dispatch Monitoring Monitor order status against committed dates; coordinate with planning, production, stores and QC to remove delays Ensure partners receive revised dates before the due date when delays occur Approve order changes, partial shipments and cancellations; ensure approvals are documented Ensure demo unit, spare parts and sample dispatches follow approved requests 3. Export Documentation and Logistics Review export documents before dispatch: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, CE certificate, conformity documents and partner-specific documents Approve freight forwarder and courier selection based on quotes, transit time and reliability Ensure dispatch intimation and tracking details reach the partner on dispatch day Resolve transit delays, damage and customs queries with the forwarder and partner Ensure statutory export records are complete: shipping bill, bank realization certificate, export incentive and duty claims 4. Payment and Receivables Control Ensure payments are tracked against agreed terms: advance and credit Review partner-wise receivables ageing weekly and report to the HoD Follow up personally on overdue accounts and recommend order hold where required Ensure invoices are closed after confirmed receipt and bank documents are filed 5. Technical Support to Sales Partners Resolve partner and end-user queries on ALAN electrosurgical generators and accessories: setup, operation, settings, compatibility and performance Diagnose reported faults and complaints with the partner, using photographs, videos and error details; guide corrective steps remotely Coordinate with service, QA and D&D when the issue needs repair, replacement or design review Ensure complaints, returns and replacements are logged, investigated and closed with recorded corrective action Identify repeat issues by product and partner; report patterns to QA and the HoD Support partner demos, product training and technical clarifications for tenders and registrations Maintain product technical documents, FAQs and troubleshooting guides for partner use 6. description:
JOB DESCRIPTION BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE Cum Senior Business Development Executive Department: Sales & Business Development 
 Location: Mumbai 
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Experience: 2-6 Years 
 Reporting To: Sales Manager / Director 
 2. About the Role We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Business Development Executive to identify new business opportunities, generate leads, acquire new B2B customers and expand the company's market presence. The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers, understanding their packaging requirements, developing business relationships, conducting sales meetings and converting prospects into customers. Candidates with experience in industrial sales, manufacturing, PP/HDPE woven bags or packaging products will be preferred. 
 3. Key Roles and Responsibilities 
 A. Lead Generation and Prospecting Identify potential B2B customers across relevant industries. Generate leads through cold calling, email outreach, referrals, networking and market research. Develop a database of prospective customers and identify their business requirements. Research companies that use PP/HDPE woven bags and other industrial packaging products. Contact decision-makers, purchasing managers and procurement teams to introduce company products. 
 B. New Business Development Develop and maintain a pipeline of potential customers. Approach new customers and create opportunities for business expansion. Understand customer requirements, product specifications and expected quantities. Arrange meetings with prospective customers to present the company's products. Follow up on enquiries and quotations to convert prospects into confirmed orders. Build long-term business relationships and identify opportunities for repeat business. 
 C. Sales Meetings and Negotiations Conduct customer meetings, product presentations and business discussions. Explain product features, specifications and suitability for customer requirements. Coordinate with the Sales Manager or management regarding pricing and commercial approvals. Discuss quantities, delivery expectations and payment terms within company guidelines. Support negotiations and follow up until the order is confirmed. 
 D. Market Research and Business Expansion Identify new industries, markets and customer segments for the company's products. Monitor competitor activities, market demand and customer preferences. Gather feedback on pricing, product quality and market requirements. Identify potential business opportunities and share market insights with management. Explore new geographical markets and customer segments as assigned. 
 E. Sales Coordination and Reporting Maintain records of leads, customer meetings, enquiries and sales opportunities. Update lead status and sales progress in the assigned CRM system or sales tracker. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly business development reports. Coordinate with the CRM Executive for customer follow-ups and enquiry tracking. Coordinate with Production, Dispatch and Accounts teams when required to support customer commitments. Share regular updates on lead conversion, pending opportunities and expected orders with the reporting manager. 
 4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Number and quality of new leads generated. Number of new customers acquired. Conversion of leads and quotations into confirmed orders. Sales revenue generated against assigned targets. Number of customer meetings and business opportunities developed. Growth in the active customer base. Accuracy and timely updating of sales reports. 5. Educational Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing or a related field is preferred. 
 Experience 2-6 years of experience in business development, B2B sales or industrial sales. Experience in manufacturing, plastic packaging, PP/HDPE woven bags or related industries will be an advantage. Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to pursue sales may be considered separately. 
 6. Required Skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Lead generation, cold calling and prospecting abilities. Customer acquisition and relationship-building skills. Negotiation and sales conversion skills. Market research and business development capabilities. Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office and CRM tools. Ability to meet sales targets and work independently. Willingness to travel for customer meetings and field sales as required. 
 7. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be confident in approaching new customers, identifying business opportunities and converting prospects into revenue. The candidate must be comfortable with B2B sales, regular follow-ups, customer meetings and field visits. Preference will be given to candidates with relevant experience in industrial packaging, PP/HDPE woven bags or manufacturing sales. 
 8. Salary and Incentives Salary will be based on the candidate's experience, relevant industry exposure, current compensation and interview performance. Performance-based incentives may be offered as per company policy. 
 9. Why Join Us? Opportunity to work in the manufacturing and industrial packaging sector. Exposure to B2B sales and business development. Opportunity to build customer networks and contribute to business growth.

description:
